```{r}
# Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}
```

```{r}
root_dir <- "~/VHH/data/"
files <- list.files(root_dir)[grepl("_db-pass.tsv", list.files(root_dir))]    # results/clean_data") # or something
files <- files[!(files %in% c("Selected-XLN-XME-XMF-SmPDE-VHHs_9-23_db-pass.tsv",
                              "S3-M02-TRIM_atleast-1_db-pass.tsv",
                              "13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1_db-pass.tsv"))]
print(files)
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame()
for (f in files){
  tmp <- read.csv(paste(root_dir, f, sep = ''), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
  tmp$Illumina <- rep(f, each = nrow(tmp))
  print(f)
  print(colnames(tmp))
  df <- rbind(df, tmp)
}
```

We only want non-vectored sequences.

```{r}
df <- df[!grepl("Vec" ,df$Illumina), ]
```

Trim CDR3s

```{r}
df$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(df$junction_aa)
```


```{r}
tmp <- c("YAEQGLYGDYLDY",
         "NADVWWYGDQSEY",
         "YAEWAYYGEFDDA",
         "KADWAFYGEFDGS",
         "YADWAFYSEFDTS",
         "NADVWGYGDQSEY",
         "NADVRWYGDQSEY",
         "YADEVAWGDRYDY",
         "KAAWSFYREFDDS")
```

Now we can perform queries

```{r}
library(parallel)

# Set the number of cores to use in parallel
num_cores <- detectCores()

# Define Query Sequence id
query_seq <- "YADWGLYGDFDDY"

# Perform parallel computation of Levenshtein distances
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
clusterExport(cl, c("query_seq", "df"))
distances <- parSapply(cl, df$consensus_sequence, calculate_levenshtein, query_seq)
stopCluster(cl)

# Store the resulting distances
df$query_dist <- distances

# Percent similarity
df$percent_sim <- 1 - (distances/nchar(query_seq))
```


```{r}
for (query_seq in tmp){
  distances <- as.vector(adist(df$junction_aa, query_seq))
  df[[paste(query_seq, '_pct_homology', sep = '')]] <- (1 - (distances/nchar(query_seq)))
}
```

```{r}
results <- data.frame()
for (query_seq in tmp){
  tmp_frame <- df[which.max(df[[paste(query_seq, '_pct_homology', sep = '')]]),]
  cat("Query:\n")
  cat(query_seq, '\n')
  cat("Located:\n")
  cat(tmp_frame$junction_aa, '\n')
  cat("Homology: ", tmp_frame[[paste(query_seq, '_pct_homology', sep = '')]][1], '\n', sep = '')
  cat('\n')
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
}
```
